item.stdout:
37-The lidar transform must be measured, not copied from this template. If the
38-vendor URDF does not provide it, launch the fallback after replacing `z` and
39-`yaw` with measured values:
40-
41-```bash
42-ros2 launch mentorpi_formation_bringup lidar_static_tf.launch.py \
43-  parent:=robot01/base_link child:=robot01/laser z:=0.15 yaw:=0.0
44-```
45-
46-Then start asynchronous 2D SLAM:
47-
48-```bash
49:ros2 launch mentorpi_formation_bringup mapping.launch.py \
50-  namespace:=robot01 scan_topic:=scan_raw \
51-  odom_frame:=robot01/odom base_frame:=robot01/base_link
52-```
53-
54-Drive the car slowly with the vendor joystick/teleop node. Use RViz2 with
55-Fixed Frame `map`, display `Map`, `LaserScan`, and `TF`. Close loops around
56-the classroom and avoid fast spins; mecanum lateral slip makes odometry less
57-reliable, so scan matching and loop closure must do the final correction.
58-Save the map only after the complete loop is stable:
59-
60-```bash
61-# The helper is installed as package data; invoke it through bash:
62:bash "$(ros2 pkg prefix mentorpi_formation_bringup)/share/mentorpi_formation_bringup/scripts/save_classroom_map.sh" ~/maps/classroom
63-# or directly:
64-ros2 run nav2_map_server map_saver_cli -f ~/maps/classroom
65-```
66-
67-The stock Hiwonder image also supplies the official one-car workflow
68-`ros2 launch slam slam.launch.py` and teleoperation command
69-`ros2 launch peripherals teleop_key_control.launch.py`. The recommended mapper
70:is `slam_toolbox` async mode: it is the maintained ROS2
71-2D SLAM package and provides loop closure and a serialized pose graph. This is
72-preferable to writing a new lidar SLAM algorithm for this classroom-scale map.
73-
74-## 2. Single-car map localization
75-
76-After the map is saved, stop mapping and start AMCL with the same calibrated
77-TF and odometry frames:
78-
79-```bash
80-ros2 launch mentorpi_formation_bringup localization.launch.py \
81-  namespace:=robot01 map:=~/maps/classroom.yaml \
82-  odom_frame:=robot01/odom base_frame:=robot01/base_link
83-ros2 topic pub --once /robot01/initialpose \
84-  geometry_msgs/PoseWithCovarianceStamped "..."
85-```
86-
87-Use RViz2 `2D Pose Estimate` to initialize, then verify `map -> robot01/odom`
88-and `robot01/odom -> robot01/base_link`. AMCL is the default static-map
89-localizer here because it is robust to kidnapped-robot recovery and does not
90-continue changing the classroom map. If continuous pose-graph localization is
91:desired, use slam_toolbox localization mode with the serialized pose graph
92:instead; do not run AMCL and slam_toolbox localization simultaneously.
93-
94-The AMCL configuration uses `nav2_amcl::OmniMotionModel`, not the differential
95-model, because the M1 mecanum chassis has real lateral velocity. The formation
96-agent consumes `/robotXX/amcl_pose` for global `map` position and covariance;
97-`/robotXX/odom` supplies body-frame velocity only. It rejects stale poses,
98-wrong frame IDs and excessive x/y/yaw covariance before publishing motion.
99-For a measured initial pose, the bundled publisher waits for the correct AMCL
100-subscriber before sending it:
101-
102-```bash
103-ros2 run mentorpi_formation_bringup set_initial_pose \
104-  --namespace robot01 --x 1.20 --y -0.75 --yaw 1.5708
105-```
106-
107-For better odometry, the optional `config/ekf_odom_imu.yaml` documents a
108-two-dimensional `robot_localization` EKF. Enable it only after replacing its
109-placeholder `/odom/raw` and `/imu/data` topics and deciding which node owns
110-the `odom -> base_link` transform. There must be exactly one TF publisher for
111-that edge.
112-
113-## 3. Four cars on one map
114-
115-Copy the same map YAML/PGM to the operator host or a map-server car. Start:
116-
117-```bash
118-ros2 launch mentorpi_formation_bringup multi_robot_localization.launch.py \
119-  map:=/home/vela/maps/classroom.yaml
120-ros2 run mentorpi_formation_bringup tf_audit
121-```
122-
123-The launch creates one global `map` and four isolated AMCL nodes. The required
124-tree is:
125-
126-```text
127-map
128-├── robot01/odom ── robot01/base_link ── robot01/laser
